schema_note: Chapter-local targeted semantic audit of NS (produced at Sonnet 5 LOW effort). Reviews only the risk set defined below at MEDIUM effort; does not remap the full chapter.
audit_scope: SPECIALIST_DETAIL units, WEAK-evidence units, CROSS_DISCIPLINE units, and units flagged requires_scope_review in crosswalk.json

reviews.title: Differential Diagnoses of Common Presentations
reviews.rationale: Organizational differential-framework unit, not itself a distinct objective; WEAK/CONTEXT_ONLY is the correct treatment.

reviews.title: Intracranial Pressure Dynamics
reviews.mcc_evidence_used: 109-10 TBI (MODERATE, primary, unchanged); 39 Headache (WEAK, secondary, unchanged)
reviews.rationale: Primary evidence already MODERATE and supports COMPONENT; WEAK secondary evidence is supplementary, not load-bearing.

reviews.title: Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension
reviews.rationale: Identical evidentiary pattern (obj 39, WEAK, RECOGNIZE depth, red-flag recognition testable competency) to SU-NS-07 (Hydrocephalus) and SU-NS-13 (Meningioma), both already COMPONENT. No principled basis for SPECIALIST_DETAIL here; internal inconsistency corrected.

reviews.title: Hydrocephalus
reviews.rationale: Already correctly classified; used as the consistency anchor for SU-NS-06.

reviews.title: Craniosynostosis
reviews.mcc_evidence_used: none found (searched: head shape, skull, pediatric)
reviews.rationale: No canonical MCC objective on abnormal skull shape/craniosynostosis in registry; correctly has no evidence and stays SPECIALIST_DETAIL.

reviews.title: Spontaneous Intracranial Hypotension
reviews.rationale: Depth already CONTEXT_ONLY (not RECOGNIZE) — unlike SU-NS-06, this unit is already treated as minimal; no inconsistency.

reviews.title: Metastatic Brain Tumours and Adult Diffuse Gliomas
reviews.rationale: Already COMPONENT/RECOGNIZE; tangential dual evidence is appropriately WEAK, no stronger single objective identified.

reviews.title: Primary CNS Lymphoma
reviews.rationale: No canonical MCC objective for ring-enhancing lesion/immunocompromised CNS mass; correctly unevidenced and CONTEXT_ONLY.

reviews.title: Meningioma
reviews.rationale: Already correctly classified; used as second consistency anchor for SU-NS-06.

reviews.title: Vestibular Schwannoma
reviews.rationale: Genuine overlap with Otolaryngology (unilateral SNHL/tinnitus objective) alongside NS surgical ownership; defensible as CROSS_DISCIPLINE, no global-ownership call made here.

reviews.title: Pituitary Adenoma
reviews.mcc_evidence_used: 115-1 Acute visual disturbance (MODERATE, primary, unchanged); 115-2 Chronic visual disturbance (WEAK, secondary, unchanged)
reviews.rationale: Genuine multi-discipline overlap (ophtho visual fields + endocrine hypersecretion/hypopituitarism + NS surgical); primary evidence already MODERATE.

reviews.title: Cerebral Abscess
reviews.rationale: Checked objective 107-1 (Fever and hyperthermia) as a possible stronger match; its causal_conditions list infective causes generically but does not name CNS/brain abscess specifically, so not clearly stronger than current evidence. Classification (COMPONENT/RECOGNIZE_AND_ACT) already appropriately reflects this as a generalist-recognizable emergency.

reviews.title: AVMs, Cavernous Malformations, Dural AVFs
reviews.rationale: Objective 41's own causal_conditions text explicitly names 'Hemorrhage - Intracerebral and cerebellar - Subarachnoid' as a covered category, a direct textual match rather than topic-adjacency. Classification stays SPECIALIST_DETAIL (technique remains specialist) but evidence strength corrected upward.

reviews.title: Cerebrospinal Fluid Fistulas
reviews.rationale: CONTEXT_ONLY depth with no evidence claim is internally consistent; no MCC objective found that names CSF fistula specifically beyond general trauma.

reviews.title: Cauda Equina Syndrome
reviews.mcc_evidence_used: 50-4 Back pain (STRONG, primary, unchanged); 47-2 Incontinence (WEAK, secondary, unchanged)
reviews.rationale: Already at the top-tier classification (DIRECT) with STRONG primary evidence; secondary WEAK evidence is supplementary only. No change warranted.

reviews.title: Syringomyelia
reviews.rationale: Objective 66 (Numbness/tingling/altered sensation) considered as a possibly better match for dissociated sensory loss, but neither objective names syringomyelia specifically; not clearly stronger evidence, so left unchanged per no-invented-evidence rule.

reviews.title: Peripheral Nerves
reviews.rationale: Genuine overlap with trauma/orthopedics/plastics nerve-repair content; defensible as CROSS_DISCIPLINE at chapter level.

reviews.title: Neurologically Determined Death / PVS
reviews.rationale: Searched registry for death/organ-donation/end-of-life objectives; none found covering formal neurological death declaration. No stronger evidence available; legal/procedural content correctly stays specialist.

reviews.title: Pediatric Neurosurgery: Spinal Dysraphism
reviews.rationale: Searched registry for newborn assessment/well-child objectives; no explicit sacral-dimple/spinal-dysraphism content found in the retrieved text to justify a stronger or different mapping.

reviews.title: Pediatric Neurosurgery: Neonatal IVH
reviews.rationale: CONTEXT_ONLY depth with no evidence claim is internally consistent; prematurity risk-factor recognition is background, not independently testable.

reviews.title: Pediatric Hydrocephalus / Dandy-Walker / Chiari
reviews.rationale: CONTEXT_ONLY depth with no evidence claim is internally consistent; congenital posterior fossa/CSF anomaly detail is specialist-level.

reviews.title: Pediatric Brain Tumours
reviews.rationale: CONTEXT_ONLY depth with no evidence claim is internally consistent; specific tumour-type framework is specialist-level.

reviews.title: Functional Neurosurgery: Movement Disorders
reviews.rationale: DBS/ablative technique is specialist; testable competency ('may be candidates for DBS, without target-selection detail') is already correctly kept at CONTEXT_ONLY, not upgraded to a dedicated recognition unit.

reviews.title: Functional Neurosurgery: Chronic Pain
reviews.rationale: OUT_OF_SCOPE_DETAIL depth already signals minimal generalist relevance; neuromodulation technique is specialist-only.

reviews.title: Surgical Management of Epilepsy
reviews.rationale: Surgical candidacy detail is specialist; already correctly limited to CONTEXT_ONLY.

reviews.title: Surgical Management of Trigeminal Neuralgia
reviews.rationale: OUT_OF_SCOPE_DETAIL depth with no evidence claim is internally consistent; procedure-level detail is specialist-only.
